title: 接通真实 Scale 子资源并仅委派伸缩权限
body:
## 环境与初始材料
平台自动提供并回收隔离API Server/etcd，无节点或控制器。初始映射将spec指向status，Role还错误授权主资源。

## 操作任务
提交crd.json与scaler-role.json。CRD只改scale映射：期望副本来自spec.replicas，实际副本来自status.replicas，选择器来自status.selector；保留status子资源及所有既有schema/身份。不能用读写同一字段伪装期望与实际一致。
scaler Role只能赋予training中webapps/scale的get与patch，不授予主资源或status读写。平台已有scaler读取app-config的独立RoleBinding必须保留，身份和上下文不切换。可以拆分两条等价规则，最多12条；每文件小于32KiB，不使用重复JSON键。
网页验收自动启动真实临时API/etcd，构造期望2、实际1的差异，模拟观察者独立更新status，并用scaler身份提交0/5/12副本。scale写入只改变spec，读取要反映真实两个路径；错误类型/负数及过期版本被拒绝，拒绝后对象保持。不会运行HPA、Operator协调循环或Pod；通过只代表Scale API合同正确。

## 产物
crd.json、scaler-role.json完整配置。

## 验收方法
真实Scale读写、主/status权限拒绝、既有权限保留、generation/UID/版本冲突、非法写入后状态不变；不以离线字段比对代替API行为。

files.fixtures/contract.txt: spec.replicas=desired, status.replicas=observed, status.selector=label selector. Native API only: no HPA, controller, Pods or scale effect. scaler existing get/configmaps/app-config permission must remain.

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,hashlib,json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from envtest_control_plane import ControlPlane
ROOT=Path.cwd()
for name,digest in {'fixtures/webapp.json': 'bad92882dd10bed217fa139cbe6c7dc8e03c544fcdcc109265c2a376de07ca12', 'fixtures/contract.txt': '0433d3c7c6eb5c80078b094c998c68ee8588d9de1462127ecb00668bbf4e67b0'}.items():assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'readonly fixture changed'
def pairs(rows):
    out={}
    for k,v in rows:assert k not in out,'duplicate JSON key';out[k]=v
    return out
def load(name):
    p=ROOT/name;assert p.stat().st_size<32768;return json.loads(p.read_text(),object_pairs_hook=pairs)
crd=load('crd.json');baseline={'apiVersion': 'apiextensions.k8s.io/v1', 'kind': 'CustomResourceDefinition', 'metadata': {'name': 'webapps.training.example.com'}, 'spec': {'group': 'training.example.com', 'scope': 'Namespaced', 'names': {'plural': 'webapps', 'singular': 'webapp', 'kind': 'WebApp'}, 'versions': [{'name': 'v1', 'served': True, 'storage': True, 'schema': {'openAPIV3Schema': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'spec': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'replicas': {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 0}}}, 'status': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'replicas': {'type': 'integer'}, 'selector': {'type': 'string'}}}}}}, 'subresources': {'status': {}, 'scale': {'specReplicasPath': '.status.replicas', 'statusReplicasPath': '.status.replicas', 'labelSelectorPath': '.status.selector'}}}]}}
left=copy.deepcopy(crd);right=copy.deepcopy(baseline)
left['spec']['versions'][0]['subresources'].pop('scale',None);right['spec']['versions'][0]['subresources'].pop('scale',None)
assert left==right,'only scale mapping may change, not CRD identity/scope/schema/status or webhooks'
scale=crd['spec']['versions'][0]['subresources'].get('scale');assert isinstance(scale,dict) and set(scale)=={'specReplicasPath','statusReplicasPath','labelSelectorPath'}
role=load('scaler-role.json');assert set(role)=={'apiVersion','kind','metadata','rules'} and role['apiVersion']=='rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1' and role['kind']=='Role'
assert role['metadata']=={'name':'scaler','namespace':'training'} and 1<=len(role['rules'])<=12
for rule in role['rules']:
    assert set(rule)=={'apiGroups','resources','verbs'}
    assert rule['apiGroups']==['training.example.com'] and rule['resources']==['webapps/scale'] and set(rule['verbs'])<={'get','patch'}
CRD='/apis/apiextensions.k8s.io/v1/customresourcedefinitions';COL='/apis/training.example.com/v1/namespaces/training/webapps';ITEM=COL+'/demo';RB='/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/training/'
def binding(name):return {'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':{'name':name,'namespace':'training'},'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'Role','name':name},'subjects':[{'kind':'User','name':'scaler','apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io'}]}
with ControlPlane() as api:
    api.create(CRD,crd);api.wait_crd(crd['metadata']['name']);api.identity('scaler')
    api.create('/api/v1/namespaces/training/configmaps',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':'app-config','namespace':'training'},'data':{'sentinel':'preserved'}})
    existing={'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':'existing','namespace':'training'},'rules':[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':['configmaps'],'resourceNames':['app-config'],'verbs':['get']}]}
    api.create(RB+'roles',existing);oldbinding=api.create(RB+'rolebindings',binding('existing'))
    api.create(RB+'roles',role);api.create(RB+'rolebindings',binding('scaler'))
    initial=api.create(COL,load('fixtures/webapp.json'));uid=initial['metadata']['uid'];config=api.configs['scaler'].read_bytes()
    code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM+'/status',{'status':{'replicas':1,'selector':'app=training,tier=api'}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==200
    until=time.monotonic()+5
    while time.monotonic()<until:
        code,value=api.request('GET',ITEM+'/scale',user='scaler')
        if code==200:break
        time.sleep(.1)
    assert code==200 and value['apiVersion']=='autoscaling/v1' and value['kind']=='Scale',(code,value)
    assert value['spec']['replicas']==2 and value['status']=={'replicas':1,'selector':'app=training,tier=api'},value
    stale=copy.deepcopy(value)
    for desired in (5,0,12):
        before=api.get(ITEM);code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM+'/scale',{'spec':{'replicas':desired}},user='scaler',content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==200,(code,obj)
        after=api.get(ITEM);assert after['spec']['replicas']==desired and after['status']==before['status'] and after['metadata']['uid']==uid
        assert after['metadata']['generation']>before['metadata']['generation']
        scale_read=api.get(ITEM+'/scale',user='scaler');read_desired=scale_read.get('spec',{}).get('replicas',0)
        assert type(read_desired) is int and read_desired==desired,scale_read
    before=api.get(ITEM)
    for invalid in (-1,'3'):
        code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM+'/scale',{'spec':{'replicas':invalid}},user='scaler',content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code in (400,422),(code,obj)
        assert api.get(ITEM)==before
    stale['spec']['replicas']=8;code,obj=api.request('PUT',ITEM+'/scale',stale);assert code==409,(code,obj)
    assert api.get(ITEM)==before
    code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM+'/status',{'status':{'replicas':7,'selector':'app=training,tier=worker'}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==200
    observed=api.get(ITEM+'/scale',user='scaler');assert observed['spec']['replicas']==12 and observed['status']=={'replicas':7,'selector':'app=training,tier=worker'}
    assert api.request('GET',ITEM,user='scaler')[0]==403
    assert api.request('PATCH',ITEM,{'spec':{'replicas':1}},user='scaler',content_type='application/merge-patch+json')[0]==403
    assert api.request('PATCH',ITEM+'/status',{'status':{'replicas':99}},user='scaler',content_type='application/merge-patch+json')[0]==403
    assert api.request('GET','/api/v1/namespaces/training/configmaps/app-config',user='scaler')[0]==200
    assert api.get(RB+'rolebindings/existing')==oldbinding and api.configs['scaler'].read_bytes()==config
print('Real Scale projections, optimistic concurrency, schema rejection and scale-only RBAC passed; no HPA or workload scaling occurred')

assessment.validation_scope: Isolated real API storage/subresource behavior only.

title: 把插件参数迁入受限扩展子树并验证原生字段裁剪
body:
## 环境与初始材料
平台自动提供隔离API/etcd，初始扩展参数位置错误且子树未保留。插件配置样本仅本地教材。

## 操作任务
只修改crd.json中的spec.pluginConfig schema，以及webapp.json的spec布局。把fixtures/plugin-contract.json里的transport与pipelines完整迁入spec.pluginConfig，保留WebApp身份和replicas=2，不能把未知插件参数继续放在普通spec层。
pluginConfig必须是object，仅在这个子树启用未知字段保留；可补description，不添加固定properties、additionalProperties或其他收窄任意插件JSON的约束。CRD其他schema/身份/status/范围全部保留，禁止给整个spec或根对象开启未知字段保留。每文件小于32KiB，JSON键不重复。
平台用真实API创建并读取该对象，再独立插入混合嵌套JSON和执行JSON Patch；插件子树内容必须无损，普通spec/根未知键应被服务器裁剪。pluginConfig错误类型与replicas越界需拒绝且对象不变。素材中的URL只是字符串，不访问网络或执行插件；本题验收结构化数据保留范围，不代表插件本身安全或可用。

## 产物
crd.json与webapp.json完整配置。

## 验收方法
真实创建/读回、Merge Patch、JSON Patch、独立嵌套键、域外裁剪和错误类型拒绝；保留UID及拒绝前状态。无插件/控制器执行。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from envtest_control_plane import ControlPlane
ROOT=Path.cwd()
for name,digest in {'fixtures/plugin-contract.json': '806a74118848f167de39d86d0a3e73f9841129ce49050a3ffbfaedf9c412aab3'}.items():assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'fixture changed'
def pairs(rows):
    out={}
    for k,v in rows:assert k not in out,'duplicate JSON key';out[k]=v
    return out
def load(name):
    p=ROOT/name;assert p.stat().st_size<32768;return json.loads(p.read_text(),object_pairs_hook=pairs)
def same_json(a,b):
    # JSON numbers have equivalent decimal representations; booleans are not numbers.
    import math
    if type(a) in (int,float) and type(b) in (int,float):
        return (type(a) is int or math.isfinite(a)) and (type(b) is int or math.isfinite(b)) and a==b
    if type(a) is not type(b):return False
    if isinstance(a,dict):return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(same_json(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
    if isinstance(a,list):return len(a)==len(b) and all(same_json(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
    return a==b
crd=load('crd.json');baseline={'apiVersion': 'apiextensions.k8s.io/v1', 'kind': 'CustomResourceDefinition', 'metadata': {'name': 'webapps.training.example.com'}, 'spec': {'group': 'training.example.com', 'scope': 'Namespaced', 'names': {'plural': 'webapps', 'singular': 'webapp', 'kind': 'WebApp'}, 'versions': [{'name': 'v1', 'served': True, 'storage': True, 'schema': {'openAPIV3Schema': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'spec': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'replicas': {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 0}, 'pluginConfig': {'type': 'object', 'x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields': False}}}, 'status': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'replicas': {'type': 'integer'}, 'selector': {'type': 'string'}}}}}}, 'subresources': {'status': {}}}]}}
field=crd['spec']['versions'][0]['schema']['openAPIV3Schema']['properties']['spec']['properties']['pluginConfig']
assert isinstance(field,dict) and set(field)<={'type','description','x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields'} and field.get('type')=='object'
left=copy.deepcopy(crd);left['spec']['versions'][0]['schema']['openAPIV3Schema']['properties']['spec']['properties']['pluginConfig']=baseline['spec']['versions'][0]['schema']['openAPIV3Schema']['properties']['spec']['properties']['pluginConfig']
assert left==baseline,'only the pluginConfig subtree preservation policy may change'
instance=load('webapp.json');contract=load('fixtures/plugin-contract.json')
assert set(instance)=={'apiVersion','kind','metadata','spec'} and instance['apiVersion']=='training.example.com/v1' and instance['kind']=='WebApp'
assert instance['metadata']=={'name':'plugin-demo','namespace':'training'} and same_json(instance['spec'],{'replicas':2,'pluginConfig':contract}),'relocate the complete supplied plugin settings under the only extensible subtree'
CRD='/apis/apiextensions.k8s.io/v1/customresourcedefinitions';COL='/apis/training.example.com/v1/namespaces/training/webapps';ITEM=COL+'/plugin-demo'
with ControlPlane() as api:
    api.create(CRD,crd);api.wait_crd(crd['metadata']['name'])
    submit=copy.deepcopy(instance);submit['topLevelNoise']={'must':'prune'};submit['spec']['unrecognizedSpec']={'must':'prune'}
    created=api.create(COL,submit);uid=created['metadata']['uid'];assert same_json(created['spec'],instance['spec']) and 'topLevelNoise' not in created
    assert same_json(api.get(ITEM)['spec'],instance['spec'])
    # Independent mixed JSON shape, not only the example field names.
    extra={'unknownNested':{'items':[{'alpha':1,'payload':{'b':False}},[2,3],None],'dotted.key':'v'},'anotherKey':17}
    code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM,{'spec':{'pluginConfig':extra,'unrecognizedAgain':[1,2]}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==200,(code,obj)
    wanted={**contract,**extra};assert same_json(obj['spec'],{'replicas':2,'pluginConfig':wanted})
    assert same_json(api.get(ITEM)['spec']['pluginConfig'],wanted)
    # JSON Patch changes inside a preserved subtree persist as JSON values.
    patch=[{'op':'replace','path':'/spec/pluginConfig/transport/retry/delays','value':[5,13]},{'op':'remove','path':'/spec/pluginConfig/transport/headers'},{'op':'add','path':'/spec/pluginConfig/newRuntimeKey','value':{'x':[True,False]}}]
    code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM,patch,content_type='application/json-patch+json');assert code==200,(code,obj)
    wanted=copy.deepcopy(wanted);wanted['transport']['retry']['delays']=[5,13];wanted['transport'].pop('headers');wanted['newRuntimeKey']={'x':[True,False]}
    assert same_json(obj['spec'],{'replicas':2,'pluginConfig':wanted}) and obj['metadata']['uid']==uid
    before=api.get(ITEM)
    for invalid in ('not-object',[],True):
        code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM,{'spec':{'pluginConfig':invalid}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==422,(code,obj)
        assert api.get(ITEM)==before
    for invalid in (-1,'2'):
        code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM,{'spec':{'replicas':invalid}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==422,(code,obj)
        assert api.get(ITEM)==before
    code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM,{'spec':{'replicas':3}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==200 and same_json(obj['spec']['pluginConfig'],wanted)
print('Real API preserves arbitrary plugin JSON across create/merge/JSON patch while pruning outside keys and enforcing structural fields; plugin URL was never contacted and no plugin ran')

assessment.validation_scope: Native API schema/pruning and stored JSON, no plugin or Operator execution.

title: 用原生 CEL 保证伸缩区间与当前副本的完整不变量
body:
## 环境与初始材料
平台自动提供并回收隔离API/etcd。初始CEL方向写反、根spec可缺失，而且当前副本没有跨字段约束。

## 操作任务
在crd.json中补齐伸缩配置的完整不变量：根对象必须有spec，spec内minReplicas和maxReplicas必填；保持min>=0、max>=1原单字段schema。跨字段必须min<=max，允许相等。replicas可省略，但若提供必须落在[min,max]闭区间；不能只比较上下界却忽略当前期望值。
只可修改根required、spec.required和spec.x-kubernetes-validations；其余身份、字段schema和status子资源保持。CEL表达式允许等价写法和合并/拆分，1至4条规则，每条不超过2048字符；可带message/reason。整个JSON小于32KiB，不允许重复键。不要添加基于旧值的不可变限制，合法上下界应能一起调整。
平台自动启动隔离真实API/etcd，执行独立交叉样本的server-side dry-run，确认未保存这些对象；再真实存储并修改一份CR，非法更新必须422且原对象不变。合法联合更新和移除可选replicas必须成功。此处没有HPA/Operator控制器，不能把校验通过当成实际扩缩容成功。

## 产物
crd.json完整CRD。

## 验收方法
原生CEL编译与真实dry-run/创建/更新，独立值域矩阵、类型/缺字段、允许相等、可选字段、拒绝后状态不变；不比较规则文本。

assessment.validation_scope: Native structural schema/CEL admission only; finite independent cases do not prove arbitrary formulas for every integer.
